item.title: Island Beach State Park — Sat Sep 19, 8:45 AM — NJ
item.description:
One of the gems of the state park system, Island Beach has miles of beach, tidal wetlands, maritime forest and thickets that can host a good diversity of birds, especially if the winds are right. There is a $5 entry fee for NJ residents who do not have a state park pass or are 65 years of age or older. Be prepared for several hours of walking on flat terrain, sometimes sandy. Bring lunch. Led by Scott Barnes and Linda Mack. A NOTE ON MEETING LOCATION! We’ll meet just outside of the park entrance, in the median parking lot at the end of Rt. 35. PRE-REGISTRATION REQUIRED COST: $25 Members, $30 Non-members REGISTER HERE
Source: NJ Audubon

item.title: Treasures of the Swamp Scavenger Hunt — Sat Sep 19, 10:00 AM — NJ
item.description: “Join us for a fun, free community family event, brought to you by the Great Swamp Partners! This 2-day treasure seeking event takes you to 7 beautiful natural areas in the Great Swamp Watershed. Explore forest trails, wildlife sightings, code-cracking, and celebratory high-fives as you solve each clue. It’s a great opportunity to experience the incredible natural beauty right here in our backyard! Begin your exploration at any of the participating locations within the Great Swamp watershed region – visit 1 or all 7 sites in any order – all at your own pace. The event ends on Sunday at NJ Audubon Scherman Hoffman Wildlife Sanctuary with a crackling campfire, snacks, and prize drawings SCHEDULE: • Saturday, September 19, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM – Scavenger Hunt • Sunday, September 20, 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM – Scavenger Hunt – and 2:00 to 3:00 PM – Celebration Event and Raffle Drawing at Scherman Hoffman COST: FREE Interested in becoming a member? item.title: Theater League of Clifton Announces Auditions for “1776” — Sat Sep 19, 7:00 PM
item.description: The Theater League of Clifton will hold auditions for its upcoming production of “1776” on Tuesday, September 15; Wednesday, September 16; and Thursday, September 17, from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Callbacks by invitation may also be held Thursday, September 17. Auditions will be held at Living Hope, 303 Maplewood Ave., Clifton, NJ 07013. Performances will be held November 13, 14 and 15 at the Wayne Community Center, 1 Pike Drive, Wayne, NJ. The production will be directed by Maren Sugarman. With music and lyrics by Sherman Edwards and a book by Peter Stone, 1776 dramatizes the struggle within the Second Continental Congress to declare American independence. John Adams, Benjamin Franklin and Thomas Jefferson attempt to persuade a divided Congress to break with England while political, regional and personal conflicts threaten to derail the effort. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled. (Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.21

Clean and gently used hardcover and softcover books: adult and children, English and other languages, fiction and nonfiction. DVDs, Blu-rays, CDs, & audio book CDs in their original printed jackets or cases. No VHS or cassette tapes, 78’s, or self-recorded media

We CANNOT ACCEPT anything that is:
Falling apart Moldy Heavily underlined Otherwise unsuitable for sale

Encyclopedia sets Reader’s Digest Condensed books (or similar) Textbooks AAA travel guides or maps Travel guides that are more than 3-4 years old (unless they are very old) Puzzles or board games Magazines VHS tapes (video tapes) Music cassettes Greeting cards or postcards
